player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely declared "DONE" upon returning to the starting room (Bar) without verifying if all reachable directions from every visited room had been explored. Specifically, I failed to check if the "east" direction from the Game room (which I visited twice) or the "east" direction from the Utility room led to unvisited areas. Next time, I will maintain a mental map of visited rooms and available directions. I will only output "DONE" when I am in a room where all available directions lead to rooms I have already visited, ensuring no unexplored paths remain. If I encounter a room with an untried direction, I will take it immediately rather than assuming the map is complete.
